The transparency obligations for providers and deployers of certain AI systems under the EU AI Act are aimed at ensuring that natural persons are informed when they are interacting with AI or exposed to AI-generated content. These obligations are particularly relevant for generative and interactive AI systems and deepfakes, and they are designed to mitigate the risks of misinformation, fraud, or consumer deception. 

These transparency obligations will take effect on August 2, 2026.
